found.quote: Griffith provides guidance and training on the ethical use of AI, including how and when to declare its use in assessments.
found.anchor: What do I need to know?

found.name: Griffith Library
found.quote: If you’re unsure whether AI is appropriate for an assessment, speak with your course convenor or reach out to the Library for guidance. Drop in to the front desk, log a service request or give us a call—as always, the Library is here to help!
